# About This Portfolio

This site is a curated collection of selected MBA coursework presented as professional work samples.

The portfolio focuses on applied leadership, strategy, healthcare, finance, and analytics. Each publication is adapted from completed academic work and reviewed for public presentation, citation accuracy, and professional context.

The complete academic archive—including working drafts, class notes, internal course materials, and other non-public files—is maintained separately in a private repository.

## Publication Approach

The goal is not to publish every assignment. It is to highlight work that demonstrates practical analysis, decision-making, communication, and the ability to connect evidence with real business and healthcare questions.
